name: Last Guardian ~Juukyou no Shugosha~
original_name: ラストガーディアン ～獣郷の守護者～
source:
Last Guardian ~Juukyou no Shugosha~ is set in a fantasy world ruled by gods and inhabited by many different races. Many years ago, two of the gods fought each other, until the god Gaduros emerged victorious, imposing a harsh rule over the nation of the Winged Beasts until the beautiful goddess Typhon defeated Gaduros.

It looked like the age of peace finally began. But when the Beasts discovered an ancient disc-like artifact, everything went wrong again. A warrior from the nation of Centaurs and a mysterious religious cult suddenly became very interested in the artifact, making it clear to the Beasts that they will have to fight for their lives. And so three of them – two young friends, Rezak and Maxen, and their older comrade Badio – started a dangerous journey across the world, to find out what their enemies' intentions truly are...

The game is a mixture of RPG and strategy. As in most RPGs, the player controls a party of characters (up to 7), who gain experience points from fighting enemies and level up. However, there is no exploration of any kind and no movement outside of the battle field in the game.
The game consists of long strategic battles and cut scenes, most of which are presented as still anime-style shots that advance the story. The turn-based battles allow free movement on the battle field. Each action (movement, physical attack, spell, etc.) requires a certain amount of action points.
Beside the usual attacks, some player-controlled characters can transform into various types of beasts. While in "beast mode", the character gains access to new abilities, but might lose some of those he/she had while in human-like form.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44429/last-guardian-jukyo-no-shugosha/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
Last Guardian ~Juukyou no Shugosha~ 的故事发生在一个由众神统治、居住着许多不同种族的奇幻世界。许多年前，两位神明互相争斗，直到神加杜罗斯取得胜利，对翼兽国家实行严厉的统治，直到美丽的女神提丰击败了加杜罗斯。

看来和平时代终于开始了。但当野兽们发现了一件古老的圆盘状神器时，一切又出了问题。一位来自半人马国家和一个神秘宗教组织的战士突然对这件神器产生了浓厚的兴趣，这让野兽们明白，他们必须为自己的生命而战。于是，他们三人——两个年轻的朋友雷扎克和马克森，以及他们的年长战友巴迪奥——开始了一段穿越世界的危险旅程，去查明敌人的真正意图……

该游戏是角色扮演游戏和策略游戏的混合体。与大多数角色扮演游戏一样，玩家控制一队角色（最多7名），他们通过与敌人战斗和升级来获得经验值。然而，游戏中没有任何形式的探索，也没有战场之外的移动。
游戏由长时间的战略战斗和过场动画组成，其中大部分以动画风格的镜头呈现，推动故事的发展。回合制战斗允许在战场上自由移动。每个动作（移动、物理攻击、法术等）都需要一定数量的动作点。
除了常见的攻击之外，一些玩家控制的角色还可以变身为各种类型的野兽。在“野兽模式”下，角色可以获得新的能力，但可能会失去他/她在类人形态下拥有的一些能力。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44429/last-guardian-jukyo-no-shugosha/]Moby Games[/url]]
